title: The same invoice in a convenient message
description: The document can be handed over the way the client is used to, while the figures keep a single history.

blocks.text: Out in the field the conversation happens in messages, while the app makes you go looking for an email address.

quote.text: I’m a tire mobile installer and been looking for an Invoice company where I can send my customers immediate pricing etc. most company don’t offer SMS text messaging only by email but Invoice does.

blocks.text: Choose the file or the link and the sending channel separately from creating the invoice. Record a repeat handover as an event on the same document.
Before sending, the recipient and the attachment need looking over; changing the channel doesn’t create a new debt.
